title: Shared LoReFT subspace with per-task Mirror coordinates
hypothesis: In a frozen linear representation screen with 16 task interventions, one rank-4 shared representation subspace plus per-task coordinates will retain held-out intervention quality at relative RMSE <=0.10 through private-variation ratio rho=0.25 while using <=0.50x actual serialized bytes of independent per-task rank-4 LoReFT-style interventions.
physical_object: One frozen identity feature map h=x in R^24 shared by all task functions; no trainable base weights are introduced.
mirror_coordinate: A task-specific four-value coefficient vector m_t multiplying four shared rank-one hidden-space directions u_j v_j^T.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen distinct linear hidden-representation interventions; four task IDs excluded from shared-basis fitting but given calibration examples for fitting their own task code.
controls: native shared rank-4 subspace plus task coefficients (same algebra as Mirror)

task.construction: Delta_t = U diag(c_t) V^T + rho*A_t diag(p_t) B_t^T, with orthonormal common U/V, independent orthonormal private A_t/B_t, seeded Gaussian coefficients; target y=(I+Delta_t)x.
task.fit: Estimate each task delta from its 128 calibration examples. Fit shared U/V from leading left/right eigenspaces of summed training-task delta covariances; fit each m_t by diagonal projection onto paired shared modes. Independent rank-r controls use truncated SVD of each estimated task delta.
task.primary_metric: heldout-task relative output RMSE = RMSE(predicted y, target y) / RMS(target intervention Delta_t x), aggregated over task IDs 12-15
secondary_metrics: causal output change when m_t is zeroed or permuted

development.selection: No hyperparameter selection; evaluate the entire frozen rho sweep.
development.hyperparameter_changes_after_run: Prohibited without numbered amendment; source is frozen before either development seed is opened.

fresh.opening_rule: Open only if quality/storage gates pass and the result has a distinct Mirror-specific margin over native shared-subspace coefficients. Exact native equality closes this Mirror-specific screen without fresh access.

storage.authority: actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: per-task intervention factors or full matrices
storage.base_identity_feature_map: identical parameter-free h=x map shared by every method; excluded from incremental intervention payload

compute.operation_proxy: count multiply-add scalar operations for intervention application; common identity residual path is excluded

gates.PROMISING: At rho=0 and rho=0.25 in both development worlds, shared-code heldout-task relative output RMSE <=0.10, payload <=0.50x independent rank-4 payload, all four heldout task codes causally change predictions, and shared intervention operations <=1.25x independent rank-4. Report native-control attribution separately.
gates.FAIL: The valid full-matrix upper replays, but a frozen quality/storage/compute gate fails, or a native shared-subspace coefficient method exactly explains the candidate with no distinct Mirror-specific advantage.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Full-matrix target replay or deterministic serialized metric replay fails.

boundaries: Synthetic aligned/misaligned hidden-state mechanism screen only; not trained-LM, behavior, NLL or downstream-task evidence.
This is a LoReFT-style low-rank hidden transform and omits the full LoReFT training stack.
Heldout logical tasks receive 128 calibration examples to fit their task codes; only the shared basis excludes those task identities.
All intervention tensors, codes and metadata bytes are charged. Fresh seeds remain sealed unless both frozen quality/storage gates and Mirror-specific attribution justify replication.
